newsOutletDelayDays.citation: Days until a local outlet's report reaches someone who follows politics most of the time (engagement 1): a public record is reported the next day. Someone who follows less hears later, in proportion (delay = this / engagement). Spread 0.5 to 2.

newsMaxAgeDays.citation: Days a story stays news: after this no outlet or conversation carries it, so people whose habits would bring it later never hear it. Spread 14 to 60.

newsStoriesPerContact.citation: Stories one person passes to another at a contact: the newest the listener has not heard. Spread 1 to 3.
